# Risk Sentinel

> Research prototype of a PhD thesis (University of Bari "Aldo Moro", Department of Earth and Geoenvironmental Sciences, in agreement with ADM, the Italian Customs and Monopolies Agency). It studies how a trigger — first of all an earthquake or a volcanic eruption — that hits a critical node (maritime chokepoint, port, production area) can create scarcity of a strategic good and, through Europe's supply vulnerability and a set of modulators, become a risk for EU customs controls before the goods arrive.

Risk Sentinel runs at https://risksentinel.opencyber.org. It is a self-hosted fork of the open-source World Monitor dashboard (AGPL-3.0, https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor); its code is at https://github.com/gstorelli/worldmonitor. It is not World Monitor: it has no public API, no MCP server, no SDK and no paid plans, and access to the dashboard requires an account.

## What the prototype does today

- The default view follows the six-layer model of the thesis: trigger → critical node → strategic good → supply vulnerability → customs vulnerability → customs risk, with modulators (tariffs, anti-dumping, sanctions, producer-country policy) and signals (news, vessel traffic, measured data) cutting across.
- It reads recent earthquakes from EMSC (USGS as fallback; last 30 days, magnitude 4.5 and above) and natural-hazard events from GDACS and NASA EONET, associates them with the critical nodes, and applies the model rule: no trigger hitting a node, or no exposed goods, means no induced risk.
- It shows the historical hazard of the critical nodes, the strategic goods (HS codes) with their EU criticality and measures in force, and inherited World Monitor layers used as signals or modulators.
- Language models are used only for text tasks on the inherited dashboard and notifications (summaries, classification). No language model measures a hazard.

## What it does not do (yet)

- The customs-vulnerability component, the corroboration rule and the constrained language-model components are designed in the thesis, not implemented.
- The inherited 8-dimension "customs risk score" uses provisional weights with no justification; it is not a result.
- No internal customs data, declarations or personal data are in this deployment. A pilot at the Customs Office of Bari (shadow mode) is planned for the third year of the thesis.
